g.text: Measured benefit and remaining error: the same 90 fixed-XY samples
Time interpolation reduced RMSE and peak-to-peak residual versus block-end subtraction, but its maximum residual was slightly larger.
These are baseline-consistency metrics, not independently measured absolute accuracy or an OrcaSlicer A/B comparison.
